40006060.author: पदार्थः
40006060.content: रामे when Rama, एवम् in this way, अर्थवत् meaningful, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having uttered, विरते had rested, ततः then, धार्मिकः righteous one, भरतः Bharata, मन्दाकिनी river Mandakini, तीरे on the bank, प्रकृतिवत्सलम् affectionate by nature, धार्मिकम् virtuous, रामम् Rama, धार्मिकम् conforming to righteouness, चित्रम् clear, वचः words, उवाच said.

40006060.author: Translation
40006060.content: Rama remained silent after saying these meaningful words on the bank of river Mandakini. Then the Bharata, conforming to righteousness, replied in clear words to the virtuous Rama who was affectionate by nature.

40006061.author: पदार्थः
40006061.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies (Rama), त्वम् you, यादृशः of such nature, ईदृशः of such person, लोके in the world, कोहि स्यात् who he may be, त्वाम् you, दुःखम् sarrow, न प्रव्यथयेत् does not pain, प्रीतिः pleasure, न वा प्रहर्षयेत् does not delight, वृद्धानाम् for the elders, सम्मतः असि beloved,  तांश्च them, संशयान् doubts, पृच्छसि ask them.

40006061.author: Translation
40006061.content: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubts.

40006062.author: पदार्थः
40006062.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies (Rama), त्वम् you, यादृशः of such nature, ईदृशः of such person, लोके in the world, कोहि स्यात् who he may be, त्वाम् you, दुःखम् sarrow, न प्रव्यथयेत् does not pain, प्रीतिः pleasure, न वा प्रहर्षयेत् does not delight, वृद्धानाम् for the elders, सम्मतः असि beloved,  तांश्च them, संशयान् doubts, पृच्छसि ask them.

40006062.author: Translation
40006062.content: O subduer of enemies, you are of such nature that neither sorrow pains you nor pleasure delights you. There are none in this world like you. You are loved by the elders, for you seek their counsel whenever you have doubts.

40006063.author: पदार्थः
40006063.content: मृतः the dead, यथा as, जीवन् while living, तथा in the same way, असति about evil man, यथा same way सति about virtuous man, तथा like that, यस्य to whom, एषः this, बुद्धिलाभः gains of intellect, स्यात् becomes, सः he, केन by what, परितप्येत is distressed.

40006063.author: Translation
40006063.content: One should accept life and death, vice and virtue equally. How can one be afflicted when he has gained such an intellect?

40006064.author: पदार्थः
40006064.content: मनुजाधिप O lord of men, यः who  त्वं यथा like you, परावरज्ञः knower of past and future, सः that person, एव this, व्यसनम् distress, प्राप्य having obtained, विषीदितुं to lament, न अर्हति is not proper.

40006064.author: Translation
40006064.content: O lord of men, it is not proper for a person like you who knows the past and the future of human beings to feel distressed and lament over it.

40006065.author: पदार्थः
40006065.content: राघव Rama, महात्मा the magnanimous one, त्वम् you, अमरोपमसत्त्वः resemble gods in nature, सत्यसङ्गरः true to your promis, सर्वज्ञः allknowing, सर्वदर्शी च allseeing, बुद्धिमांश्च असि you are a man of wisdom.

40006065.author: Translation
40006065.content: O magnanimous Rama, your nature is divine and you are true to your promises. You are omniscient, allseeing and wise.

40006066.author: पदार्थः
40006066.content: एवं गुणैः by such virtues, युक्तम् endowed with, प्रभवाभवकोविदम् cognizant of life and death, त्वाम् you, अविषह्यतमम् insufferable, दुःखम् grief, आसादयितुम् to reach, नार्हति not proper.

40006066.author: Translation
40006066.content: It is not proper for a virtuous man like you, who is cognizant in matters of life and death, to be overwhelmed by such insufferable grief.

40006067.author: पदार्थः
40006067.content: मयि me, प्रोषिते when I was away from home, क्षुद्रया by the meanminded, मात्रा by mother, मत्कारणात् for my sake, यत् पापम् which sin, कृतम् has been committed, तत् that one, मे to me, अनिष्टम् that disagreeable act, भवान् you, मम me, प्रसीदतु graciously pardon.

40006067.author: Translation
40006067.content: When I was away from home, my meanminded mother committed a sin for my sake which I never wished. You may pardon me graciously.

40006068.author: पदार्थः
40006068.content: धर्मबन्धेन by a bond of righteousness, बद्धः अस्मि I am bound, तेन for that reason, इह now, दण्डार्हाम् deserving punishment, पापकारिणीम् doing sinful acts, इमां मातरम् this mother, तीव्रेण severe, दण्डेन punishment, न हन्मि do not slay.

40006068.author: Translation
40006068.content: I am bound by a bond of righteousness for which I am unble to slay my mother who deserves severe punishment for her sinful acts.

40006069.author: पदार्थः
40006069.content: शुद्धाभिजनकर्मणः of noble race and righteous deeds, दशरथात् from Dasaratha, जातः born of, धर्मम् righteousness, जानन् knowing, अधर्मिष्ठम् unrighteous, जुगुप्सितम् reprehensible, कर्म deed, कथम् how, कुर्याम् shall I do?.

40006069.author: Translation
40006069.content: How shall I, born to Dasaratha of noble race and righteous deeds, with the knowledge of dharma, do such a reprehensible and unrighteous deed?

40006070.author: पदार्थः
40006070.content: गुरुः preceptor, क्रियावान् one who is devoted to meritorious acts, वृद्धश्च old, राजा king, प्रेतः departed soul, पिता father, इति च for this, दैवतं चेति as a god, संसदि in the assembly, तातम् father, न परिगर्हेयम् I cannot reproach.

40006070.author: Translation
40006070.content: King Dasaratha, my father and preceptor, is godlike to me. Devoted to meritorious acts, he departed from this world in his old age. For this reason, I cannot reproach him (publicly) in this assembly (of men).

40006071.author: पदार्थः
40006071.content: धर्मज्ञ O knower of ways of righteousness, धर्मवित् knower of righeousness, को हि who indeed, स्त्रियाः for the sake of a women, प्रियम् pleasure, चिकीर्षुः सन् desirous of doing, धर्मार्थयोः for dharma and artha, हीनम् bereft of, किल्बिषम् sinful, ईदृशम् this kind of, कर्म act, कुर्यात् will do?

40006071.author: Translation
40006071.content: O Rama, conversant with righteousness, will any one who knows the meaning of righteousness, do such a sinful act contrary to dharma and artha to please a woman?

40006072.author: पदार्थः
40006072.content: भूतानि living beings, अन्तकाले at the time of death, मुह्यन्ति are deluded, इति thus, पुराश्रुतिः ancient saying, एवम् in this way, कुर्वता by doing, राज्ञा by the king, सा श्रुतिः that adage, लोके in this world, प्रत्यक्षं explicitly, कृता has been made.

40006072.author: Translation
40006072.content: There is an ancient saying that at the time of death, the intellect of people is deluded. By conducting himself in this way, king Dasaratha has proved it.

40006073.author: पदार्थः
40006073.content: क्रोधात् due to anger, मोहात् due to delusion, साहसात् due to a spirit of adventure, तातस्य father's, यत् अतिक्रान्तम् whichever trangression, तत् that, भवान् you, साधु prudently, अर्थम् meaning, अभिसन्धाय having thought over, प्रत्याहरतु will set it right.

40006073.author: Translation
40006073.content: Our father has trangressed righteousness due to anger or delusion or recklessness. Therefore, you may think over the matter prudently and set it right.

40006074.author: पदार्थः
40006074.content: यः पुत्रः that son, पितुः father's, समतिक्रान्तम् transgressions, साधु as right, मन्यते sets, तत् that son, लोके in the world, अपत्यम् as son, मतम् is considered, अतः for this, अन्यथा contrary happens, विपरीतम् reverse is so.

40006074.author: Translation
40006074.content: One who sets right the wrongs done by his father is a true son. Otherwise the son becomes just the opposite. (He is not  a son to the father).

40006075.author: पदार्थः
40006075.content: भवान् you, तत् अपत्यम् अस्तु be such a son, लोके in this world, धीरविगर्हितम् condemned by men of wisdom, दुष्कृतम् sinful, पितुः father's, कृतम् committed, कर्म act, भवान् you, अभिपत्ता an approver, मास्तु let not become.

40006075.author: Translation
40006075.content: So be a worthy son and let not the sinful act committed by our father and condemned by men of wisdom be approved by you.

40006076.author: पदार्थः
40006076.content: भवान् you, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, मां च me, तातं च father also, नः our, सुहृदः friends, बान्धवांश्च relations, सर्वान् all, पौरजानपदान् inhabitants of the city and countryside, सर्वम् entire, इदम् this kingodm, त्रातु protect.

40006076.author: Translation
40006076.content: Protect this entire kingdom, Kaikeyi, me and father, our friends and relations, citizens of the city and inhabitants of the countryside.

40006077.author: पदार्थः
40006077.content: अरण्यं च the forest, क्व where, क्षात्रं च kshatriya'a duty, क्व where, जटाः matted locks, क्व where, पालनं च governance of the kingdom, क्व where, भवान् you, ईदृशम् such, व्याहतम् repulsive, कर्म act, कर्तुम् to do, न अर्हति not proper.

40006077.author: Translation
40006077.content: Where is the forest and where is kshatriya's duty? Where are matted locks and where is governance of the kingdom? It does not behave you to do such acts antithetical to each other.

40006078.author: पदार्थः
40006078.content: महाप्राज्ञ O sagacious one, येन by whom, प्रजानाम् of the subjects', परिपालनम् governance, शक्यम् is possible, एषः this one, क्षत्रियस्य kshatriya's, अभिषेचनम् to be crowned, प्रथमः primary, धर्मः हि duty indeed.

40006078.author: Translation
40006078.content: O sagacious one, the primary duty of a kshatriya is to be crowned. This enables him to rule his subjects.

40006079.author: पदार्थः
40006079.content: कः who, क्षत्रबन्धुः a kshatriya, प्रत्यक्षम् first duty, उत्सृज्य abandoning संशयस्थम् doubtful, अलक्षणम् inauspcious, आयतिस्थम् standing at a remote future, अनिश्चितम् uncertain, धर्मम् righteousness, चरेत् will follow?

40006079.author: Translation
40006079.content: Will any kshatriya, setting aside his first duty, follow an uncertain course of piety which is contrary to his dharma and whose impact may be felt in a remote future.

40006080.author: पदार्थः
40006080.content: अथ or, त्वम् you, क्लेशजम् born of physical exertion, धर्ममेव righteousness, चरितुम् to follow, इच्छसि यदि if you desire, चतुरः four, वर्णान् castes of social order, धर्मेण righteously, पालयन् governing, क्लेशम् exhaustion, आप्नुहि obtain.

40006080.author: Translation
40006080.content: If you so desire to follow the path of dharma acquired out of physical exertion, then bear the trouble of governing the four castes of the social order righteously.

40006081.author: पदार्थः
40006081.content: धर्मज्ञ one who is cognizant of duty, गार्हस्थ्यम् life a of householder, चतुर्णाम् the four, आश्रमाणाम् among modes of life, श्रेष्ठम् foremost, आश्रमम् mode of life, धर्मज्ञाः knowers of dharma, प्राहुः हि say, तम्  that one, त्यक्तुम् to renounce, कथम् how, अर्हसि are entitled?

40006081.author: Translation
40006081.content: O Rama, you are the one who knows his duty. The knowers of dharma maintain that the life of a householder is the foremost among the four modes of life. How can you renounce it?

40006082.author: पदार्थः
40006082.content: अहम् I, श्रुतेन in knowledge, स्थानेन in position, जन्मना in birth, भवतः compared to you, बालः हि am younger, सः such me, भवति when you, तिष्ठति while living, भूमिम् the earth, कथम् how, पालयिष्यामि can I rule?

40006082.author: Translation
40006082.content: Being younger to you in knowledge, position and birth, how can I rule the earth when you are present?

40006083.author: पदार्थः
40006083.content: हीनबुद्धिगुणः deficient in intelligence and virtue, स्थानेन चापि even in position, हीनः low, बालः child, अहम् I, भवता by you, विनाभूतः deserted, वर्तयितुम् to live, न उत्सहे I  do not desire.

40006083.author: Translation
40006083.content: I am a child, deficient in intelligence and virtue and even inferior in position. Deserted by  you, I do not wish to live.

40006084.author: पदार्थः
40006084.content: धर्मज्ञ O one, conversant with righteousness, पित्य्रम् relating to our father, निखिलम् entire, इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, अव्यग्रम् quietly, अकण्टकम् without hindrance बान्धवैस्सह with the relations, स्वधर्मेण in accordance with your duty, अनुशाधि rule .

40006084.author: Translation
40006084.content: O one, conversant with righteousness rule unhindered this entire kingdom along with our relations inherited from our father.

40006085.author: पदार्थः
40006085.content: सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, सवसिष्ठाः including Vasistha, मन्त्रकोविदाः wellversed in the Vedic hymns, ऋत्विजश्च priests also, सह along with, त्वा you, इहैव here itself, मन्त्रवत् with sacred texts अभिषिञ्चन्तु may consecrate.

40006085.author: Translation
40006085.content: Let all ministers, subjects, and priests including Vasistha who are wellversed in Vedic hymns consecrate you here itself.

40006086.author: पदार्थः
40006086.content: त्वम् you, अभिषिक्तः being consecrated, अस्माभिः along with us, पालने to govern, तरसा with vigour, लोकान् all the worlds, विजित्य having conquered, वासवः Indra, मरुद्भिरिव like Indra with Maruts, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, व्रज return.

40006086.author: Translation
40006086.content: After consecration, you too return to rule Ayodhya along with all of us like Indra who went back (to heaven), accompanied by Maruts after conquering all the worlds with his prowess.

40006087.author: पदार्थः
40006087.content: त्रीणि three, ऋणानि debts, अपाकुर्वन् discharging, दुर्हृदः enemies, साधु completely, निर्धहन्  subduing, सुहृदः friends, कामैः with desires, तर्पयन् gratifying, अत्र in Ayodhya, त्वमेव you alone, माम् me, अनुशाधि rule.

40006087.author: Translation
40006087.content: Discharging completely the three debts, to gods, to ancestors and to sages, subduing your enemies and gratifying your friends, you alone (have the right) to dictate me.

40006088.author: पदार्थः
40006088.content: आर्य O esteemed one, अद्य now, अभिषेचने at enthronement, ते your, सुहृदः friends, मुदिताः सन्तु let them be delighted, अद्य today, ते दुर्हृदः your enemies, भीताः frightened, दश दिशः in ten different directions, पलायन्ताम् will run away.

40006088.author: Translation
40006088.content: O my esteemed brother let all your friends be delighted today at your enthronement and your enemies flee in terror in ten different directions.

40006089.author: पदार्थः
40006089.content: पुरुषर्षभ O best of men, अद्य now, मम my, मातुः mother's, आक्रोशम् censure, प्रमृज्य wiping away, तत्र भवन्तम् revered one, पितरं च father also, किल्बिषात् from sin, रक्ष protect.

40006089.author: Translation
40006089.content: O best of men, wiping out all the censure on my mother, redeem our revered father from sin.

40006090.author: पदार्थः
40006090.content: अहम् I, शिरसा with my head bowed low, त्वा you, अभियाचे beseech, मयि in me, सर्वेषु every one of, बान्धवेषु relations, भूतेषु in all living beings, महेश्वरः इव like Maheswara, करुणाम् compassion, कुरुष्व do.

40006090.author: Translation
40006090.content: I beseech you with my head bowed low, show mercy on me and every one of our relations, like Maheswara showing compassion on all living beings.

40006091.author: पदार्थः
40006091.content: अथ or, भवान् you, एतत् all these solicitations, पृष्ठतः कृत्वा keeping back, इतः from here, वनमेव to the forest itself, गमिष्यति if you set out, अहमपि I also, भवता सार्धम् along with you, गमिष्यामि I shall go.

40006091.author: Translation
40006091.content: If you turn your back on my solicitations and set out for the forest I shall also go along with you from here itself.

40006092.author: पदार्थः
40006092.content: ताम्यता by the distressed, भरतेन by Bharata, तथा in that way, शिरसा with head bowed low, प्रसाद्यमानः propitiated, महीपतिः lord of the earth, सत्त्ववान् virtuous, रामः Rama, पितुः father's, तद्वचने in the words (of his father), प्रतिष्ठितः established, गमनाय to go back, मतिम् resolve, न चक्रे did not make.

40006092.author: Translation
40006092.content: Thus besought and propitiated by Bharata with his head bowed low and distressed, the virtuous lord of the world, Rama, firmly established in the words of his father, resolved not to go back to Ayodhya.

40006093.author: पदार्थः
40006093.content: राघवे in Rama, अद्भुतम् that wonderful, तत् स्थैर्यम् that determination, अवेक्ष्य having seen, जनः all men, दुःखितः anguished, समम् simultaneously, हर्षम् delight, अवाप obtained, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, न याति will not go, इति thus, दुःखितः अभवत् were grieved, स्थिरप्रतिज्ञत्वम् firmness of resolve, अवेक्ष्य having seen, हर्षितः were delighted.

40006093.author: Translation
40006093.content: Having seen the wonderful deternmination of Rama, people were, at once, anguished and delighted, anguished because he would not return to Ayodhya, and delighted because he was firm in his resolve.

40006094.author: पदार्थः
40006094.content: ऋत्विजः the priests, नैगमयूथवल्लभाः the chiefs of merchant organizations, विसंज्ञाश्रुकलाः    with senses switched off and tears drained dry, मातरः mothers, तदा then, तथा in that way, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, तं भरतम् that Bharata, प्रतुष्टुवुः extolled, रामम् to Rama, प्रणम्य   reverentially saluting, सह together, ययाचिरे च implored.

40006094.author: Translation
40006094.content: All the priests, the chiefs of merchant organizations and mothers who had their senses switched off and theif tears drained dry extolled Bharata for his words. All of them, reverentially saluting Rama, implored him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षडुत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredsixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
